title: 第23章 配合第24章 意识
content_zh:
它身体很轻，灵巧地向前飘了几步，稳稳停在一个既安全又能有效打击怪物的位置。
它微微张嘴，对着正疯狂追逐凯撒的血肉怪物，轻轻吹出了一口气。
“呼——”
一股夹杂着细小冰粒的刺骨寒气，精准地缠上了怪物身上那道被凯撒巨剑撕裂开的伤口。
“嗤——！”
伤口表面瞬间凝结了一层薄冰，那原本疯狂蠕动的血肉，以肉眼可见地迟速度缓下来。
怪物追逐的动作猛地一僵，随即爆发出痛苦嚎叫。
凯撒的压力骤然一轻，他立刻死死抓住了这转瞬即逝的机会！
“干得好，小咔！”
凯撒心中狂喜。
他不再犹豫，趁着怪物因伤口冻结而动作迟滞的刹那，手中那把猩红大剑骤然爆发出刺眼的猩红光芒！
“给我……开！”
凯撒倾尽全身力量，巨剑狠狠劈砍在怪物那道覆盖着冰霜的巨大伤口之上！
“噗嗤——！”
这一次，效果截然不同！
失去了快速愈合的能力，怪物的坚韧的血肉被狂暴地劈开！
剑刃深深嵌入血肉，甚至砍在骨头之上，发出沉闷的骨裂声！
“嗷吼——！”
怪物疼得疯狂咆哮，庞大的身躯因剧痛而猛烈摇晃！
猩红大剑贪婪地吸食着怪物的生命力，一股汹涌的生命力涌入凯撒的身体。

这股力量瞬间治愈了他先前的创伤，也将累积的疲惫一扫而空。
“有用！”
凯撒心中狂吼！
战斗的天平，开始倾斜了！
凯撒和小咔，一个主攻，一个控制，两人无需言语，却形成了惊人的默契。
小咔在战场边缘轻盈移动，每次吹出的寒气都精准地覆盖在凯撒刚刚制造的新鲜伤口上。
凯撒也不再一味闪避，他利用自身迅捷的速度，围绕着庞大的怪物游走攻击，剑刃专门砍向小咔寒气冻结之处。
“噗！”
趁着怪物被寒气侵袭得动作僵硬，站立不稳的瞬间，猩红大剑狠狠捅进了它相对脆弱的腋下深处！
“吼——！”
怪物痛吼着，抡起粗壮的臂膀狂暴横扫。
凯撒早已敏捷地矮身避开，同时反手一剑，精准地削断了它后腿被寒气冻结的脚踝！
content_en:
Its body is very light, and it floats forward a few steps nimbly, stopping firmly in a position that is both safe and effective in attacking monsters.
It opened its mouth slightly and blew out a breath towards the flesh-and-blood monster that was madly chasing Caesar.
"Huh——"
A biting cold air mixed with tiny ice particles accurately wrapped around the wound on the monster's body that was torn apart by Caesar's giant sword.
"Tsk-!"
A thin layer of ice instantly condensed on the surface of the wound, and the flesh and blood that had been crawling crazily slowed down at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The monster's chasing movement suddenly froze, and then it burst into painful howls.
Caesar's pressure suddenly eased, and he immediately seized this fleeting opportunity!
"Good job, Kaka!"
Caesar's heart was filled with ecstasy.
He no longer hesitated, taking advantage of the moment when the monster's movements were sluggish due to the frozen wound, the scarlet sword in his hand suddenly burst out with a dazzling scarlet light!
"Let me... open it!"
Caesar used all his strength and slashed the monster's huge wound covered with frost with his giant sword!
"Pfft——!"
This time, the effect is completely different!
Losing the ability to heal quickly, the monster's tough flesh was violently split open!
The blade of the sword was deeply embedded in the flesh and blood, and even struck the bones, making a dull sound of bone cracking!
"Ouch--!"
The monster roared crazily in pain, and its huge body shook violently due to the severe pain!
The scarlet sword greedily sucked the monster's life force, and a surge of life force poured into Caesar's body.
This power instantly healed his previous wounds and wiped away the accumulated fatigue.
"It works!"
Caesar roared in his heart!
The balance of the battle is beginning to tilt!
Caesar and Xiao Ka, one is the main attacker and the other is in control. The two of them do not need words, but they have formed an amazing tacit understanding.
Xiaoka moved lightly on the edge of the battlefield, and every time he blew out the cold air, it accurately covered the fresh wounds Caesar had just made.
Caesar no longer dodges blindly. He uses his quick speed to move around the huge monster and attack. The blade specifically cuts at the place where Xiaoka's cold air freezes.
"Poof!"
Taking advantage of the moment when the monster's movements were stiff due to the cold air and it was unsteady on its feet, the scarlet sword was stabbed deep into its relatively fragile armpit!
"Ho--!"
The monster roared in pain, raised its thick arms and swept violently.
Caesar had already nimbly ducked to avoid it, and at the same time, with a backhand sword, he accurately cut off the ankle of its hind leg that was frozen by the cold air!
